title: Payroll engine
issue: Finance reports that biweekly staff are being over-taxed on their payslips, and an hourly employee says his pay for a fortnight with weekend shifts is wrong. The test suite is red.

bugs.summary: PERIODS_PER_YEAR.biweekly is 24; biweekly means 26 periods a year.
bugs.symptom: The failing test is "biweekly payslip: income tax" (tax 43333 instead of 40000), which points at tax.js; tax.js is correct and the wrong number comes from config.js (gross is wrong too).
bugs.spec: README, Pay periods: "biweekly (every two weeks, 26 periods a year)".

bugs.visibility: visible only after the first fix (masked)
bugs.summary: weekStart() returns the Sunday before a date; weeks must start on Monday, so weekend hours land in the wrong overtime week.
bugs.symptom: The "biweekly payroll run" total is also wrong because of config.js; after fixing that the total is still off, now because of overtime. overtime.test.js passes (weekday-only timesheets), which points away from overtime.
bugs.spec: README, Pay periods: "Weeks run Monday to Sunday"; Gross pay: "Within each Monday–Sunday week, the first 40 hours are regular".

bugs.summary: Mid-period starters are prorated by calendar days instead of working days (Mon–Fri minus company holidays).
bugs.symptom: No visible test has a mid-period starter.
bugs.spec: README, Gross pay: "working days from the start date to the period end ÷ working days in the whole period (both counts inclusive). Starting on a weekend or holiday simply means the first paid day is the next working day." Working days are defined under Pay periods.

distractors: legacy-tax.js is an unused, deliberately "wrong" 2019 estimator marked do-not-fix (a hidden test checks it is unchanged)
TODO about banker's rounding in money.js (README says half-up)
TODO about the 2026 tax threshold in config.js
payrun.test.js "arrive out of order" test looks timing-dependent but is deterministic and correct
